verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap documents that applications creating transcription jobs can receive completion updates through webhooks, and its changelog adds a webhook callback when a job is canceled, so callers do not have to poll. The evidence is thin, though: it consists of a product-facts line and a changelog entry, with no detailed webhook reference. Missing for 10: an explicit webhook on job failure, documentation of callback registration, payload, retries and signing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
